final: WITH race_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_avgs AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg) as country_avg_wins FROM race_avgs GROUP BY country), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as global_avg FROM country_avgs), above_global AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg_wins FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE ca.country_avg_wins > ga.global_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as group_avg FROM above_global) SELECT ag.country, ROUND(ag.country_avg_wins, 4) as avg_wins, ROUND(ag.country_avg_wins - ga.global_avg, 4) as above_global, ROUND(ag.country_avg_wins - grp.group_avg, 4) as above_group_avg FROM above_global ag CROSS JOIN global_avg ga CROSS JOIN group_avg grp WHERE ag.country_avg_wins > grp.group_avg ORDER BY ag.country_avg_wins DESC
